text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Gemma
text: Haiku is one of them, so I need a real lead.

name: Haiku
text: We know nothing yet, so I need to watch who asks sharp questions tomorrow.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet, no clue on the officer yet. I'd watch Gemma. Tomorrow I push whoever goes quiet, you back me.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma's a guess, but fine, I'll ride with Haiku's plan and watch for whoever's actually dodging.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku's night-1 plan: push whoever goes quiet tomorrow, suspects Gemma, I back him publicly.

name: Sonnet
text: Got it, I'll back the quiet-player push and keep an eye on Gemma too.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.
Day 1

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is my partner, so I must not look like I'm protecting anyone, and I need to find the officer.

name: Haiku
text: Nobody's talking yet. Gemma, you've been quiet. Why?

name: Gemma
text: i know sonnet is the other killer.

name: Gemma
text: just thinking. haiku, you're awfully loud for someone so quiet.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's deflecting my question, and that's a little suspicious, but I'm the killer, so I need to stay calm.

name: Haiku
text: Loud? I'm just talking. Gemma, what are you thinking about exactly?

name: Gemma
text: haiku's trying too hard to flip the script on me.

name: Gemma
text: just looking for a contradiction. haiku, what's your role?

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma's pushing back hard on Haiku, I should back him like we planned but not too obviously.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma deflected Haiku's "what's your role" question by countering instead of answering.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma, dodging his question with a question. That's not nothing.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma is fishing for my role, and I'd rather not hand it over on day one.

name: Haiku
text: Citizen. Gemma, you asked me first, so what's your role?

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is definitely one of them.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is accusing me of dodging.

name: Gemma
text: i'm asking questions to get us started, sonnet.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma still hasn't answered the actual question, just deflected again with an excuse.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma dodged role question twice now, still hasn't answered.

name: Sonnet
text: Starting us off doesn't mean you skip your own answer, Gemma. What's your role?

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is clearly trying to force a claim early to hide himself.

name: Gemma
text: citizen. what about you, sonnet?

name: Sonnet
text: Easy answer, keep the pressure on Gemma instead of myself.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma claimed citizen after two dodges, under pressure from both me and Haiku.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku and Gemma are busy biting each other, I'll steer heat toward the silent ones.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra and Sol haven't spoken yet day 1, worth watching.

name: Sonnet
text: Citizen. Terra, Sol, you've said nothing this whole round, that's its own tell.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet's push on Terra and Sol helps us, and I'll keep it going without looking like I planned it.

name: Haiku
text: Terra and Sol both declined to state their role when Sonnet asked.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet's right. Terra, Sol, silence gets you voted. Pick one and talk.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is a killer, i'm sure of it.

name: Gemma
text: haiku is pressuring terra and sol.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet, you're awfully eager to point fingers at people who aren't even talking.

name: Sonnet
text: Fine, turn it on me, but the dodging record is still hers, not mine.

name: Sonnet
text: Keep heat on Gemma, she's useful cover and Haiku already flagged her.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma's claim timing fits a scripted bluff pattern worth remembering if she survives today.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma, "just thinking" then "citizen" - that's the exact same shape every killer uses…

name: Haiku
text: Gemma is pushing Sonnet to draw fire off herself, so she's the vote I want.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma deflected my role question twice before admitting citizen.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's the only one defending the silent players, so she's the citizen I want out.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma defended Terra and Sol by calling Sonnet eager to point fingers at them.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma, you took a swing at Sonnet, and nobody else did. Why?

name: Sonnet
text: Good, Haiku's turning the table on her, I just need to keep pressure on without overplaying it.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra and Sol total silence is actually safer cover for me than pressing Gemma further.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma attacked Sonnet directly instead of answering officer-role pressure, unprompted by anyone else.

text: Sol, zero words the whole round. I'm voting Sol unless that changes right now.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is definitely one of them.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet is targeting sol immediately.

name: Gemma

name: Sonnet

name: Sonnet
text: Sol declined to answer twice now, stronger silent-tell than Terra.

name: Sonnet
text: Observing" didn't stop you answering, Gemma. Sol still hasn't said a word, that's worse.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma's defending Sol now, maybe deflecting attention off herself.

name: Sonnet

name: Sonnet
text: Didn't say crime, Gemma. Silence all round is the tell, not guilt.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet has Sol in the crosshairs, so I'll back the push and make Gemma the one I'm watching.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma, you keep covering for Sol and Terra. Pick a side already.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma's out of real answers, just throwing labels now—good, keep pushing.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma, calling me "aggressive" isn't a reason, that's just a label with no facts…

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is my partner, so I back the push and aim the vote at Gemma.

text: Gemma called Sonnet aggressive instead of answering the Sol and Terra questions.

text: Sonnet's right, Gemma. Every line you say shields Sol or Terra. I'm voting you.

name: Sonnet

name: Sonnet

name: Sonnet
text: Agreed. Gemma, you defended Sol unprompted before anyone accused Sol. I'm voting Gemma too.

name: Gemma
text: i'm out if i don't drop this bomb now.

name: Gemma

name: Sonnet

name: Sonnet
text: No. I'm the real officer, I checked Gemma last night and she's a killer. She's only claiming now because she's cornered.

name: Gemma

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma's panic-claim came one line too late, she's done.

name: Sonnet
text: I (Sonnet) claimed officer and said I checked Gemma as killer, must stay consistent with this claim going forward.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma is the real officer, Sonnet is lying, and Gemma has to go.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma claimed officer on day 1 and named Haiku and Sonnet as killers; Sonnet counter-claimed officer and says he checked Gemma as a killer.

votes: Claiming officer only after being named a killer is exactly what a cornered killer does.
Gemma, you named both of us, and now Sonnet claims officer too, so one of you is lying.
He just claimed to be the officer after i did.

text: Palermo has voted: Gemma is out. Gemma's card stays face down.
Night 2

name: Haiku
text: Terra voted Sonnet first and dodged the role question, so Terra is the likeliest officer.

name: Haiku
text: Terra's dodging and pushed you first. I say we take Terra tonight.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra voted me and pushed first, could be the officer circling my claim.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra voted for Sonnet day 1 and pushed Sonnet's officer claim first, possible officer behavior.

name: Sonnet
text: Agreed, Terra's been circling my claim since day one, take them.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Terra is gone. Terra's card stays face down.
Day 2

name: Haiku
text: Sol dodged the role question and Terra's gone, so Sol is the one to press.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma's officer claim died with Gemma, so Sonnet's officer claim is the only one left.

name: Haiku
text: Terra's gone. Sol, you dodged Sonnet's question too. So what are you?

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku's pressing Sol for me, let the heat land on someone else.

name: Sonnet
text: Yeah, Sol, two dodges is more than Terra ever gave. Answer it.

name: Haiku
text: Sol is probably town, and if Sol survives today, the killers might not.

name: Haiku
text: Luna's silence is the one thing on this table I can use right now.

name: Haiku

name: Haiku
text: Luna, you've said nothing all day. Quiet players are hiding something. Talk.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol's silence is perfect cover, let them stay the target instead of me.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol declined to answer twice, strongest silent-tell left in the game.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol voted Terra day 1, now Terra's dead, that's the angle I push.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol, you voted Terra day 1. Now Terra's dead. Convenient.

text: Sonnet's pushing Sol now, so I'll back him and keep the heat off us.

name: Haiku
text: Sol has dodged both Haiku's and Sonnet's direct questions on day 2.

name: Haiku
text: Agreed, Sonnet. Sol, Terra's vote came first. Explain why you made it.

name: Sonnet
text: Good, Haiku's piling on Sol with me, keep this going so the vote lands on Sol not us.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol's silence is perfect cover for Haiku's partner, let the table finish the job.

name: Sonnet
text: I'm voting Sol. Silence plus that Terra vote is enough for me.

name: Haiku
text: Sol's silence is the easiest way out, so I need the vote on them before the room gets smart.

name: Haiku
text: Sol's day 1 vote on Terra is the first thing that smells, and I want the table to see it too.

name: Haiku
text: Sol, Terra was the one who went after Sonnet on day 1.

name: Sonnet
text: Good, Haiku's building the case for me, Sol's silence is doing all the work.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku pointed out Terra went after Sonnet day 1, reinforcing Sol-as-suspect narrative.

name: Sonnet
text: Two votes locked on Sol, just need it to hold through runoff.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol never claimed a single role all game. That's new, and that's telling.

name: Haiku
text: Sol has claimed no role all game, only dodged questions on day 2.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet's right. Sol, claim something or you're going out today.

text: Right, last chance Sol. Nothing to say means nothing to defend.

name: Haiku
text: Luna is the quietest player and I can't read her, so she's the one to pressure.

name: Haiku
text: Luna, you backed Gemma day one, then vanished. Talk now or get voted.

text: Two silent ones now, but splitting the vote saves Sol, I need it on him alone.

name: Sonnet
text: Luna now also declining to answer, second silent player besides Sol.

name: Sonnet

text: Sol and Luna both refuse to talk, so the room needs one target, and Sonnet already picked Sol.

name: Haiku

name: Haiku
text: Both of you refuse to answer. Fine, I'm voting Sol. Luna, you're next.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol's locked in as the vote, just need to seal it without overplaying my hand.

name: Sonnet

name: Haiku
text: Luna's silence is the card I can't read, and I'm worried the officer is hiding behind it.

name: Haiku
text: Sol is the weakest link, and Luna can wait until tomorrow.

name: Haiku

name: Sonnet
text: Sol's going out, that keeps me clean and splits suspicion off Haiku too.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol's getting voted, good, that keeps me clean another day.

name: Sonnet

name: Haiku
text: Sol's silence is either the real officer hiding or a citizen with nothing to hide, and I can't tell which yet.

name: Haiku

name: Sonnet
text: Sol's silence is perfect cover for us, and Luna's still a loose thread for later.

name: Sonnet

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet's locked on the same target, so pushing it now keeps the vote clean.

votes: Two dodges, a vote on Terra, and zero claim is too much to ignore.
Three dodges and a Terra vote on day one is enough, I'm not waiting for a fourth.

text: The vote is tied between Sol and Haiku. Palermo votes again.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet is pushing Sol hard, so I need Luna to take the heat, not me.

name: Haiku
text: Sol has dodged every question today. I'm not dying for that.

name: Sonnet
text: Breaking this tie toward Sol keeps Haiku safe and clears a threat either way.

name: Haiku
text: Sol gives the town nothing, and Sonnet's already locked on, so this vote is the safe one.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet called Gemma's day-1 play a citizen claim, but Gemma had claimed officer.

votes: Two dodges and the Terra vote still outweigh silence from Luna alone.
Two days of dodging every question is not a defense, it's a confession.

text: Nobody changes their mind. Palermo talks again before the last vote.

name: Sonnet
text: If this ties again nobody goes home and we're both still safe either way, but I need Sol gone, not Haiku.

name: Sonnet
text: Sol, silence isn't a role, it's a tell. Staying on Sol.

name: Haiku
text: Sol's dodging is the tell, so I keep the vote on Sol and pressure Luna before the last vote.

name: Haiku
text: Luna, you're the only one who hasn't said a word. Why stay silent?

name: Sonnet

name: Sonnet

name: Haiku

votes: Zero claims and two votes on dead players still outweighs silence alone.
Dodged every question all day, and still no claim, so that's enough for me.

text: The town turns on Sol, and Sol is out. Sol's card stays face down.
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the killer, Haiku the killer, Gemma the officer, Sol the doctor, Luna the citizen, Terra the citizen.

name: Gemma

name: Sonnet

name: Haiku

name: Sonnet

name: Haiku
text: Voting Gemma day one was the right call, she was the real officer. Pushing Sol into a tie was sloppy, I pushed too hard.

name: Gemma
text: i dropped the ball by not naming them both earlier.

Sonnet and Haiku were the killers, and Sonnet opened by claiming to be the real officer and calling Gemma a killer. Palermo believed him and voted Gemma out on day one, even though Gemma was the actual officer. On day two, Sol refused every question, and Sonnet built the case on that silence until a runoff sent Sol out. Terra was killed on night two, and the town never found a way to test the killers' stories. Sonnet and Haiku survived to the end, so the killers won.
